# Stickyy 1.2.1
## Links that behave like links
- URLs inside a scratchpad now appear in blue with an underline. - Click a detected URL to open it in the default browser.
## More context, still minimal
- Click **Stickyy** in the menu-bar scratchpad header to reveal the active note title. - The title returns to **Stickyy** after five seconds or immediately when clicked again.
## Faster clipboard capture
- The newest clipboard item appears as a compact button in the bottom-right of the floating note. - Click it to insert text or attach the copied image or file. - The full Clipboard Pills shelf remains hidden from the floating note.
## A clearer first launch and every update
- New users reliably receive the interactive onboarding tour and welcome note. - Existing users receive a dedicated **Latest update 1.2.1 and the features** scratchpad once after upgrading. - The Drag Stickyy into Applications window now preserves its custom installer background and layout.
